NVDA.thesis: The bull carries a conditional long-horizon growth case because revenue expansion is accompanied by high realized profitability and positive cash generation. Fresh peer releases do not negate those operations or prove supplier-order losses, though they increase the importance of cash-conversion scrutiny. This is not a finding that the new price is cheap or that an immediate tactical entry is supported.
NVDA.strongest_counterexample: Quarterly FCF fell from $48.587bn to $21.4bn, statements are91 days old, customer financing economics face new scrutiny and the current valuation remains unverified; growth can still yield poor shareholder returns.
invalidation_conditions: Two subsequent comparable quarters with year-over-year revenue growth at or below0% would invalidate the sustained expansion foundation.
Two consecutive reported quarters with free cash flow at or below zero would invalidate reliance on continued cash-generative operating growth.
evidence_gaps: Updated quarterly results and complete current debt maturity/liquidity review.
Measured NVIDIA-order impact from hyperscaler cash and capex changes.
decisive_factors: Realized quarterly revenue and operating profit are strong.
Provider FCF remains positive but fell sequentially.
Peer cloud growth and cash burn do not measure NVIDIA orders or cancellations.

GOOGL.thesis: The bear carries the objection to adding immediately: a completed gap decline and oversold RSI do not repair two negative cash quarters or quantify the return after common issuance. Operating growth remains strong, so the evidence supports waiting for owner-cash, dilution or valuation clarity rather than declaring structural business failure. The old overnight uncertainty is superseded by a completed daily bar.
GOOGL.strongest_counterexample: Group operating income grew30%, Cloud already earned$11.121bn, and TTM FCF remains positive at$19.747bn; the investment cycle could be productive and a sharp repricing could precede recovery.
invalidation_conditions: Two subsequent positive-FCF quarters with no net common-share issuance would undermine the current cash-and-dilution basis for waiting.
Reported TTM FCF at or below zero would invalidate the still-positive trailing cash foundation and require a more adverse reassessment.
evidence_gaps: Validated recurring earnings valuation excluding investment distortions.
Complete current debt disaggregation and per-share investment-payback assessment.
Reliable completed post-gap reversal evidence beyond the first sell-off bar.
decisive_factors: Revenue grew25%, operating income30%, and Cloud operating profit reached$11.121bn.
Quarterly FCF was negative twice consecutively while common shares were issued.
The completed October29 daily bar contains the gap and extreme oversold momentum.

AVGO.thesis: The bull carries a conditional long-horizon growth case because strong realized revenue expansion produces substantial current FCF. Mixed customer cloud-growth and cash-return evidence does not establish supplier-order impairment, but it increases the need to monitor concentrated financing exposure. The ruling does not establish cheapness or a tactical reversal.
AVGO.strongest_counterexample: Reported debt of$59.419bn, customer concentration and unquantified residual-value support can create shareholder losses even if current quarterly FCF is strong; no verified valuation shows compensation for those risks.
invalidation_conditions: Two consecutive comparable quarters with free cash flow at or below zero would invalidate reliance on cash-generative growth.
Two consecutive quarters with year-over-year revenue growth at or below zero would invalidate the sustained expansion premise.
A disclosed residual-value support payment exceeding the observed$13.665bn quarterly FCF would invalidate the premise that current cash generation comfortably absorbs that exposure.
evidence_gaps: Quantified residual-value support terms and exposure.
Complete updated maturity and liquidity reconciliation.
decisive_factors: Revenue rose86% and quarterly FCF was$13.665bn.
The$63bn financing SPV is not current recognized sales.
Residual-value support and concentration expose shareholders to unquantified outcomes.

VT.thesis: Neither side establishes a tactical edge because both depend on missing ETF-specific diligence. The core-allocation rationale remains coherent and is distinct from a claim that this entry is unusually attractive. Positive broad breadth supplies context, not measured VT constituent attribution.
VT.strongest_counterexample: Long-horizon global-core accumulation can be rational without a short-term catalyst or an exceptional discount; neutral timing need not delay an established allocation policy.
invalidation_conditions: A complete dated review supplying look-through valuation, executable NAV premium/discount and tracking difference would invalidate the present coverage-gap basis for withholding a tactical assessment.
A verified change in the fund objective away from diversified global equities would invalidate the assumed core-role rationale.
evidence_gaps: Dated NAV premium/discount and tracking measurements.
decisive_factors: A corporate earnings model cannot fully assess this ETF.
Market breadth and cap-weighted index returns differ.
No verified exceptional entry discount was established.

1155.thesis: Stable observed banking buffers support retaining an income-and-resilience thesis, but a single-quarter recovery and unquantified product launch do not establish an attractive fresh purchase. The bear establishes patience rather than structural impairment. Neutral best reflects dated operating evidence and missing valuation.
1155.strongest_counterexample: The bank reported CET1 of14.92%, total capital18.68%, Q2 profit growth and NIM2.10%; those are tangible resilience and recovery observations even before the new business-development opportunity.
invalidation_conditions: Two subsequent comparable quarters with attributable-profit growth above0% plus a dated validated valuation assessment would undermine the unconfirmed-recovery basis for neutrality.
A subsequent comparable report with CET1 below the observed14.92% and attributable-profit growth below0% would weaken the stable-buffer-and-earnings thesis and require adverse reassessment.
evidence_gaps: Post-June30 asset-quality, funding-margin and capital data.
Validated bank valuation and current dividend coverage.
Measured group earnings effect of the new account product.
decisive_factors: Q2 profit recovered but H1 profit was slightly below prior year.
Reported capital and liquidity observations are June30 data.
The new product launch is real but its group earnings effect is unquantified.

5258.thesis: The bear carries the argument against an immediate add because a quarterly recovery and small bounce do not establish a sustained, adequately priced turnaround. Nearly flat H1 earnings,122-day-old credit evidence and weak-volume stabilization favor waiting. This is not an automatic liquidation verdict on an existing recovery exposure.
5258.strongest_counterexample: Q2 attributable profit rose9.8%, with reported capital17.8% and impaired financing0.98%; those facts preserve a credible recovery scenario despite weak timing evidence.
invalidation_conditions: Two subsequent comparable quarters with attributable-profit growth above0% and impaired financing at or below the observed0.98% would undermine the unconfirmed-recovery basis for waiting.
A subsequent report with attributable-profit growth below0% and impaired financing above0.98% would weaken the stable-credit recovery scenario and require a more adverse assessment.
evidence_gaps: Post-June30 funding-margin, asset-quality and capital observations.
decisive_factors: Q2 profit rose9.8% but H1 profit was nearly flat.
Capital17.8% and impaired financing0.98% are June30 observations.
Industrial FCF is not an appropriate independent bank-distress test.
